category.name: Casings
category.description: Replacement top covers, bottom casings and palmrests for cracked, dented or badly worn laptop bodies — priced and listed by exact model so you know it fits before you order.

faqs.question: How do I know this casing fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows the exact compatible model and which panel it covers (top cover, bottom cover or palmrest). If you're unsure, send us a photo of your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Does the casing come with a keyboard or trackpad fitted?
faqs.answer: This is stated on each product page — some palmrests include the trackpad, others are the bare panel only.

faqs.question: Can I fit this myself?
faqs.answer: It involves a full teardown of the laptop, so most customers have it fitted by us. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if you'd rather do it yourself.
